Select IC50 activity records against the human single-protein target Glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta (CHEMBL262). Return columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback to docs.doi), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL262', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and at least one of docs.pubmed_id or docs.doi is non-null. Join path: activities (on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id) → assays (on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid) → activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno → molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno (INNER JOIN) → activities.record_id = compound_records.record_id → activities.doc_id = docs.doc_id. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
